# Wiretap 0.1.1

This release focuses on reliable, balanced call recording across native macOS apps, speakers, microphones, and Bluetooth route changes.

## Highlights

- Capture microphone and system audio when recording starts before or during an active native call.
- Preserve correct timing when VoIP apps change the microphone sample rate, clock, or channel layout.
- Handle the three-channel microphone buffers exposed by native call mode without losing or stretching audio.
- Keep local speech audible when Sound Isolation misclassifies already-processed call audio.
- Automatically level quiet microphone and call audio while leaving normal-volume media unchanged.
- Continue recording through Bluetooth and default-device transitions without silent gaps or stale inputs.
- Harden long recordings, interrupted finalization, source recovery, and corrupted-output detection.

## Requirements

- macOS 15 or later.
- Microphone permission.
- Screen & System Audio Recording permission. macOS may request an app relaunch after this permission is first granted.

## Install

1. Download `Wiretap-0.1.1.dmg` below.
2. Open the DMG and drag Wiretap into Applications.
3. Replace the previous version if prompted.
4. Launch Wiretap and complete the permission setup.

The DMG is signed with Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and published with a SHA-256 checksum.
